label: Solar Priority
info:
Automatically uses solar instead of shore power when panels can cover AC loads.
Uses PV open-circuit voltage to estimate available solar capacity (even when MPPTs are idle),
then probes by disconnecting shore to confirm. Self-tunes the estimate over time.

States: shore -> probe (60s MPPT ramp) -> solar -> shore
See SETUP comment node for configuration.

name: SETUP — read me after import
info:
After importing this flow:

1. Open 'PV Voltage' node: select one of your MPPT solar chargers from the Service dropdown.
   (Pick whichever MPPT has the larger panel array, or either if they're identical.)
2. Open 'AC Input Control' node: select your Quattro from the Service dropdown.
3. Verify the 3 'victron-input-system' nodes auto-discovered (PV Power, AC Load, SOC).
   If not, open each and select 'Venus system'.
4. Deploy.
5. Set 'PV Capacity' slider on VRM (Solar group) to your total rated panel wattage.
6. Toggle 'Solar Priority' ON via VRM dashboard (Solar group).

Tunable thresholds are at the top of the 'Decision Logic' function node:
  VOC_ZERO (30V) — PV voltage below which power is ~0
  VOC_FULL (80V) — PV voltage at full sun (adjust to your panels' Voc)
  SOLAR_MARGIN (1.2) — PV must beat load by 20%
  RAMP_TIME_MS (60000) — 60s for MPPTs to reach full output during probe
  LOAD_EXCEED_MS (15000) — 15s grace before switching back to shore
  COOLDOWN_MS (300000) — 5 min anti-cycling between transitions
  MIN_SOC (40%) — won't probe below this
  SOC_EMERGENCY (30%) — immediate shore reconnect

The self-tune 'gain' factor adjusts automatically after each probe.
It starts at 1.0 and converges to the real ratio between your Voc curve
and actual power output. Visible in the Decision Logic node status.
